author: /root/dependency_inventory
scope: Exactly 44 delivered new Lean files directly in the third-batch 30 task directories and their actual direct imports. Nested frozen prior-batch copies are excluded. Source inventory and installation suggestions only; no compilation or full transitive closure.
resolution_policy: Extract actual direct imports while ignoring comments/strings. Verify candidate hashes against exact candidate registry source records.
Prefer each candidate registry exact module/path/SHA pins; cross-check duplicate pins across users of each direct module.
Resolve exact pinned paths or deterministic production module paths only; never search/select a held draft by same-name matching.
Explicit registry .txt source-to-module mappings are valid; sources longer than the Windows path limit are read with the extended-length prefix without changing authoritative path/bytes.
Mark AMBIGUOUS for multiple exact candidates, MISSING for absent exact local source and PIN_MISMATCH for stale/unverified pins.
Absent Mathlib source has null source hash and MISSING status; revision stays pinned by the existing manifest. No external source is fetched/copied.
not_performed: No compiler/Lean/lake/numerical checker, repair, installation, copy, quota or Git operation.
No change to production, author files or prior-batch files.
No recursive dependency closure, external API/theorem/axiom audit or kernel credit.
